summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K announcing the irrevocable optional early redemption of all its outstanding 4.750% Non-Step-Up Non-Cumulative Contingent Convertible Perpetual Tier 1 Securities (CoCos), CUSIP 05971KAH2, listed on the NYSE. The full nominal amount of USD 298.4 million is to be redeemed on 12 November 2026, the first optional redemption date, at par plus accrued but unpaid distributions to that date. The European Central Bank authorised the action. With all outstanding CoCos retired, watch regulatory capital ratios, any replacement Tier 1 issuance, and the clean-up of this legacy US-dollar instrument.
